how_to_choose: Read this file first. Pick ONE template_id per video. If two fit, use the decision tree below in order.
decision_tree: 2. Severe problem / animal limping / machine breakdown? -> hazard-rescue
4. Explains how something works in steps? -> how-it-works
5. Process itself is satisfying to watch? -> satisfying
6. About a person / job / story? -> story
7. None fits clearly? -> how-it-works (default) and report why in the agent log.

rules: Never invent a template_id, text_anim, transition or filter. Only values listed in the chosen template file.
Each template changes structure (beat order/length), not just colours. Do not force all videos into HOOK-BUILD-CLIMAX-PAYOFF.
One video = one template_id. Do not mix two templates in one video.
Per-video override lives in that video's JSON only. Permanent change edits the template file + bumps version + test-renders 1 clip.
